svg.title: A controlled public entry point to your private UI
svg.desc: The upper logical view shows browser HTTPS traffic to Application Gateway, the private UI in an internal Container Apps environment, and Foundry APIs through a private endpoint. A public IP is associated with the gateway frontend, not drawn as a separate traffic hop. The lower view shows three subnets and their private IP allocations, with dashed associations from the gateway, Container Apps environment, and private endpoint. Resources are not nested inside subnet boxes. Placement in the logical view does not imply network location.
svg.text: A controlled public entry point to your private UI
